candidates.change_summary: Replace the call value msg.value with 0 so no ETH is forwarded to the target.
Delete the revert on call failure so go() no longer reverts when the target call fails.
Delete the transfer to the owner so the remaining balance is never swept out of the contract.
Remove the revert on failed external call so go() no longer reverts when target.call fails.
Change the value forwarded to the target call from msg.value to 0.
Remove the transfer of the remaining balance to the owner at the end of go().
Invert the success check so go() reverts when the external call succeeds instead of when it fails.
Delete the `if (!_s) revert();` check so a failed call to target no longer causes go() to revert.
Invert the revert condition so go() reverts when the target call succeeds instead of when it fails.
Delete the final transfer to owner so the contract's balance is no longer forwarded to the owner.
Replace forwarding the full balance with forwarding msg.value to the owner, changing the amount sent when the contract balance differs from msg.value.
Delete the statement that transfers the remaining balance to the owner, so funds stay in the contract after go().
Change the sweep to send msg.value to owner instead of the full contract balance.
Change the recipient of the final transfer from owner to msg.sender.
Delete the revert on call failure so go() succeeds even when the target call fails, and still sweeps the balance to owner.
Forward zero value to the target call, so funds are not sent to target but swept to owner instead.
Remove the revert on call failure so a failed external call no longer reverts go().
Forward 0 wei to the target instead of msg.value.
Remove the final transfer to the owner so leftover funds stay in the contract.
Send the remaining balance to the target instead of the owner.
Remove the revert-on-failure check so a failed low-level call to target no longer reverts and execution continues.
Delete the final statement that transfers the contract's remaining balance to the owner.
Send 0 instead of msg.value in the low-level call to target.
Transfer the remaining balance to target instead of the owner.
Move the owner-transfer statement to before the low-level call so the owner receives the pre-call balance (zero sent with the value still forwarded).
Replace forwarding the remaining balance to owner with sending it to the target instead.
Delete the final transfer of the remaining balance to the owner, leaving funds in the contract.
Delete the revert on call failure so go() completes even when the target call fails.
Move the transfer to the owner before the external call so it executes before funds are sent to the target.
Remove the statement that transfers the remaining contract balance to the owner, so funds stay in the contract after go().
Remove the revert() so the call proceeds and the balance transfer still executes even when the external call to target fails.
Forward the entire contract balance instead of msg.value to the target call.
Keep nothing for the owner by transferring zero instead of the contract balance after the external call.
Move the owner transfer statement before the external call so the balance is swept to the owner before msg.value arrives and msg.value is left in the contract.
